changes: Run Assessment: Fixed console input detection for Electron IPC execution. The script's interactive menu detection was failing when run from the Electron app via stream-powershell, causing 'Cannot read keys when console input has been redirected' errors. Enhanced detection now tests SetCursorPosition capability and wraps the entire interactive block in a try-catch fallback, ensuring the numbered menu always works when arrow-key navigation isn't available (Electron IPC, VS Code Run, piped input, etc.).

Rename Domain Objects: Fixed domain removal always being skipped. Remove-AcceptedDomain does not exist in Exchange Online (accepted domains are synced from Entra ID), so the v2.9.161 check could never pass regardless of role. The domain is now deleted from Entra via Microsoft Graph (DELETE /domains/{id}, needs Global Admin or Domain Name Administrator). Before deleting, it lists any objects still referencing the domain (domainNameReferences - users, groups, apps) and reports the domain as BLOCKED instead of failing with a generic error. .onmicrosoft.com domains are always skipped.

Rename Domain Objects: 'Skip rename operations' now works without a Discovery folder. With the box ticked, only the Old Domain is required - the script removes that domain from the tenant directly and does not load or connect to Exchange Online. -DiscoveryFolder and -NewDomain are now optional script parameters (NewDomain still required when a Discovery folder is given).
Added Copy-CrossTenantOneDriveFile.ps1 and Copy-CrossTenantOneDriveFolder.ps1; updated Run-Assessment.ps1 and import-x500.ps1.
GUI: Bumped renderer.js cache-busting version to v=2.9.193.

GUI: Updated cache-busting version numbers in index.html. Changed renderer.js from v=2.9.92 to v=2.9.191 and main.css from v=2.9.113 to v=2.9.191. This forces the browser to reload the latest JavaScript and CSS files instead of using old cached versions. Fixes issue where fixes like button reset weren't working because old cached code was being used.

GUI: Reduced sidebar submenu item spacing to fix Domain Removal section being cut off. Changed .sidebar-subitem vertical padding from 10px to 7px, saving 6px per item. The 'Check AD References' option at the bottom of Domain Removal is now fully visible without scrolling.

Retire Devices: Added user list filtering to selectively retire devices. Upload a text file with usernames (one per line) to only retire devices owned by those users. This prevents retiring devices for users who have an old domain alias but aren't being migrated and need their devices to continue working. GUI has new 'User List File' field, script has -UserListFile parameter. Matches against OwnerUPN column in devices CSV (case-insensitive). Leave blank to retire all devices as before.

Assessment & Discovery: Added license information with friendly names. Discovery already had 22_UserLicenses.csv (one row per user with LicenseNames column showing friendly names like 'Microsoft 365 E3', 'Business Premium') and 22a_LicenseCounts.csv (aggregate counts per SKU). Assessment now also exports this - added 'User Licenses' and 'License Counts' sheets to Excel workbook and 24_UserLicenses.csv + 25_LicenseCounts.csv to CSV output. Use for reference when assigning licenses in the new tenant.

Run Assessment: Fixed button not resetting after script completes. Added defensive error handling and console logging to diagnose button state issues. The finally block now has explicit null checks and error catching to ensure the button always resets. Console logs show script lifecycle (start, complete, button reset) for debugging. Check DevTools console (Ctrl+Shift+I) if button still doesn't reset - the logs will show exactly where it's failing.

Run Assessment: Output now goes into domain-specific subfolders (matching Discovery behavior). If output folder is C:\M365Discovery and domain is trapezegroup.me, all files (Raw, MappingFiles, CSV, Excel) are saved to C:\M365Discovery\trapezegroup.me\. Keeps multi-domain assessments organized and consistent with Discovery output structure.

Run Assessment: Now exports ALL workbook sheets to CSV (23 files total, up from 12). Added: AD Groups, Transport Rules, Power Platform, Connectors, Remote Domains, Journal Rules, Mailbox Permissions, Mail-Enabled Security Groups, Dynamic Distribution Groups, Resource Mailboxes, AD Group Memberships. Assessment collects more data than search-domain in some areas (e.g. mailbox permissions, journal rules, connectors) but still doesn't collect Planner Plans, Proxy Addresses filter, or Entra CA/Auth policies that search-domain has.

Discovery: Output files now go into domain-specific subfolders. If output folder is C:\M365Discovery and domain is trapezegroup.me, files are saved to C:\M365Discovery\trapezegroup.me\. Makes it easier to organize multi-domain discoveries and keeps each domain's files separate.

Run Assessment: Show log panel when assessment starts. Fixed the log section visibility - was using style.display but the element has a 'hidden' class, so now uses classList.remove('hidden'). You can now see the real-time PowerShell output as the assessment runs.

Critical fix: Resolved JavaScript error 'stopDashboardAutoRefresh is not defined' that was preventing ANY view from loading (including Run Assessment). The error was caused by a scope issue - stopDashboardAutoRefresh was being called from switchView but was defined in a different scope. Now uses a wrapper function pattern like the monitor timer. This was blocking loadDiscoveryDomains() from ever running, which is why the Assessment dropdown never populated.

Debug: Added console logging to loadDiscoveryDomains() to diagnose why Assessment dropdown isn't populating. Logs VBU CSV path, load results, and final domain count. Check DevTools console (Ctrl+Shift+I) when opening Run Assessment view to see if VBU CSV is configured and loading correctly.

Run Assessment: Output Folder field now auto-populates from Discovery Output Path in settings. Uses the same output folder configured for Discovery, so you don't have to browse each time. You can still override it or leave blank for the default Assessment subfolder.

Run Assessment: Fixed dropdown actually loading VBU data - now calls loadDiscoveryDomains() instead of loadTargetDomain(). v2.9.179 called the wrong function (loadTargetDomain only sets target domain field, doesn't populate _vbuRows/_vbuMap). Now properly loads domains from VBU ID CSV file configured in Discovery settings.

Run Assessment: Fixed dropdown not responding to clicks - now loads VBU domain data from Discovery settings when the view opens. The dropdown UI was added in v2.9.178 but the data loading wasn't triggered, leaving _vbuRows/_vbuMap empty. Now calls loadTargetDomain() when run-assessment view is shown, same as other domain views.

Run Assessment: VBU Domain is now a dropdown that reads from the VBU ID file (same as Discovery view). Select domain from dropdown or type to filter. Auto-fills VBU ID when domain selected. Uses same domain combobox pattern as Discovery - supports keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Escape), search filtering, and displays VBU Name alongside domain.

Run Assessment: Fixed blank GUI bug - added 'run-assessment': 'runAssessmentView' mapping to switchView function. The view was created but not registered in the viewMap, causing the view switch to fail silently. Now clicking Run Assessment properly shows the assessment form instead of blank screen.

Run Assessment: Fixed SharePoint connection WAM error by adding -UseSystemBrowser flag to Connect-SPOService. Fixes 'Unable to load DLL msalruntime' and 'No valid OAuth 2.0 authentication session exists' errors when running from Electron app. Also disconnects any stale SPO session before connecting. Same fix proven in provision-onedrives.ps1 - opens OS default browser instead of popup window.

Run Assessment: Complete GUI integration - now runs inline in the Electron app with streaming output instead of separate PowerShell windows. Added dedicated view with input fields for VBU Domain, Search Term, VBU ID, SPO Admin URL, Output Folder. Run-Assessment.ps1 now accepts command-line parameters (-VbuDomain, -VbuSearchTerm, -VbuId, -SharePointAdminUrl, -OutputPath) and skips the mode menu when VbuDomain is provided. Fixes duplicate launch bug (changed from data-script to data-view). Same workflow, better UX - parameters pre-filled in GUI, output streams to log panel, no separate windows.

Electron app Provision OneDrives: Added '⚡ Force Provisioning' button that calls Force-OneDriveProvisioning.ps1 for stuck OneDrives. Shows confirmation dialog warning that synchronous mode may take several minutes. Use when OneDrives haven't provisioned after running Start Provisioning. Button appears between 'Check Status' and 'Start Provisioning' in orange/warning color.

Added Force-OneDriveProvisioning.ps1 - diagnoses and force-provisions OneDrives that failed to provision after running provision-onedrives.ps1. Checks: OneDrive existence via Graph, user license status, account enabled status. Force-provisions WITHOUT -NoWait (synchronous mode) to ensure actual completion. Helps resolve stuck provisioning requests that haven't completed after days. Shows which users have license issues (no license, disabled account, user not found) vs users that just need force-provisioning.

Electron app Discovery sidebar: Removed 'M365 Discovery' option - now only 'Run Assessment' is available. Assessment workflow (v2.9.171) exports BOTH the Excel workbook AND individual CSV files, so there's no need for separate discovery workflows. Simplifies the UI to one discovery option.

Assessment workflow: Now exports individual CSV files (search-domain.ps1 format) to CSV subfolder after building the Excel workbook. Scripts that rely on discovery CSV files can now use Assessment output. Exports: 01_AcceptedDomains, 02_ADUsers, 02b_UserMailboxes, 03_DistributionGroups, 04_MailContacts, 05_SharedMailboxes, 06_M365Groups, 07_AppRegistrations, 08_EnterpriseApps, 09_SharePointSites, 10_OneDrives, 11_Teams, 12_Devices. Gives you BOTH the consolidated Excel workbook AND the individual CSV files in one run.

Assessment workflow: Pin ALL Microsoft.Graph.* modules to v2.33.0 for assembly version compatibility. Previous fix only pinned Graph.Authentication which caused other Graph modules (Groups, Teams, Users, DeviceManagement) to fail loading with 'Assembly with same name is already loaded' errors. Now all Graph modules load v2.33.0 together. DeviceManagement v2.33.0 is optional (soft-fail) since it may not be installed - devices collection will be skipped if missing.

Assessment workflow: Fixed Graph MSAL assembly conflict by pinning Microsoft.Graph.Authentication to v2.33.0 (last version before mandatory WAM) and adding -DisableWAM to Connect-ExchangeOnline. Fixes 'Method not found: Microsoft.Identity.Client.BaseAbstractApplicationBuilder.WithLogging' error when Graph tries to connect after Exchange. Same workaround that makes search-domain.ps1 work reliably.

Assessment workflow: Made VBUId and VBUSearchTerm optional parameters in New-AssessmentContext - now accept empty strings with defaults. Fixes 'Cannot bind argument to parameter because it is an empty string' errors when running Run-Assessment.ps1 and leaving these fields blank. Empty VBUSearchTerm means objects are filtered by domain only (Test-WholeWordMatch returns false for empty terms).

Mapping file generation: Now accepts BOTH Assessment workbook format AND Discovery output format. The script auto-detects the format and handles sheet name differences (_Summary vs Assessment Summary, M365Groups vs M365 Groups, ADUsers vs AD Users, SharedMailboxes vs Shared Mailboxes, SharePointSites vs SharePoint Sites). Discovery format uses Owner/UserPrincipalName for OneDrive mappings instead of OwnerUPN. Fixes 'Cannot index into a null array' errors when generating mappings from search-domain.ps1 discovery files. VBU name fallback extracts from filename when not found in summary sheet.

AOS Setup: Added default values (OurVolaris / ourvolaris / OurVolaris App) and auto-load from saved config. Fields auto-populate when opening the view - saved config overrides defaults. Added getSharedConfig to preload.js to support auto-loading.
Fixed AOS sign-in error - exposed saveSharedConfig function in preload.js. Resolves 'window.electronAPI.saveSharedConfig is not a function' error when signing in to AvePoint Online Services.

Added export-group-aliases.ps1 (generic group alias export tool) - replaces export-faragroupaliases.ps1. Accepts -Domains parameter, -SearchPattern for wildcard matching, or prompts for domain names interactively. Exports group secondary SMTP aliases with GroupType column for migration.

Added export-aliases.ps1 (generic alias export tool) - replaces export-faraaliases.ps1. Accepts -Domains parameter, -SearchPattern for wildcard matching, or prompts for domain names interactively. Exports secondary SMTP aliases to CSV for migration to new tenant.

Rename Domain Objects: Added optional Admin Account field to force login with specific Exchange Administrator account - disconnects existing session and prompts for fresh login with specified UPN. Use this when your current account lacks Exchange Administrator permissions needed to remove accepted domains.

Rename Domain Objects: Added cmdlet availability check for Remove-AcceptedDomain - now provides helpful error message and manual removal instructions via M365 Admin Center instead of cryptic 'cmdlet not recognized' error when Exchange Administrator role is missing
Settings dialog: Removed confirmation alert and added automatic page reload after clicking Save All - settings now apply immediately with a cleaner UX

Mapping file generation: Now automatically creates CSV versions alongside each XLSX mapping file - both formats written to the FLY output folder with matching filenames ({name}-mapping.xlsx + {name}-mapping.csv). Fixes import workflows that expect .csv but were only getting .xlsx

OneDrive provisioning: Added -CheckExisting option to provision-onedrives.ps1 that checks which OneDrives already exist via Microsoft Graph, exports them to CSV (for Fly migration start), and automatically provisions only the missing ones - combines check + export + provision workflow into one fast async operation
OneDrive provisioning UI: Export CSV browse changed from file picker to folder picker with auto-generated filename ({mapping}_provisioned.csv) - simpler workflow

Discovery (search-domain.ps1): Added Members column to 03_DistributionGroups.csv export with pipe-delimited member email addresses, plus HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled property - required by New-DistributionGroups.ps1 for Create Target DLs workflow. Members are fetched when -IncludeMembers flag is used
Discovery GUI: Now automatically passes -IncludeMembers flag to search-domain.ps1 - DL membership is always captured without manual flag entry, fixing 'No Members column' error in Create Target DLs
Fixed OneDrive export folder browser that wasn't working due to require('path') not available in Electron renderer - now uses plain JavaScript string manipulation

Fixed Electron app Discovery panel to actually use search-domain.ps1 with streaming output instead of launching Run-Assessment.ps1 in a separate window - the v2.9.154 changelog claimed this was fixed but renderer.js still had the old code. Now streams search-domain.ps1 directly into the panel via window.electronAPI.onPsOutput, loops client-side for multi-domain batches, passes -Domain/-OutputPath/-BusinessUnitId/-SkipPowerPlatform parameters, and respects the Continue on Error checkbox
Fixed corrupted version.json file that was missing closing JSON brackets, causing update checks to fail with 'Version string portion was too short or too long' error

Electron app Discovery sidebar: Added 'Run Assessment' menu item between 'M365 Discovery' and 'Refresh Discovery Cache' that launches Assessment/Run-Assessment.ps1 directly in a new PowerShell window with its interactive workflow - gives quick access to the modern assessment engine from the main app sidebar

Discovery menu (discovery-menu.ps1): Added a third scan scope option 'Run Assessment (new)' alongside Single domain and Multiple domains - launches the modern Run-Assessment.ps1 workflow directly in a clean PowerShell window with its interactive mode menu and prompts, giving users direct access to the new assessment engine without needing domain/search-term pre-entry. Domain-specific options (VBU ID, Search Term, Output folder, SPO Admin URL, Skip checkboxes) are hidden when this mode is selected since the script handles all inputs interactively

Fixed Power Platform module loading conflict in discovery (search-domain.ps1): Removed Ensure-Module pre-check from both upfront and mid-run Power Platform scans that was trying to import Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell in the main session (where Microsoft.Graph is already loaded), causing Microsoft.Identity.Client assembly version conflicts. Both scans now spawn the isolated child pwsh.exe process directly without the pre-check, so the Power Platform module imports cleanly in its own session with no Graph SDK present

v2.9.153's discovery-engine revert only fixed discovery-menu.ps1 (a standalone WinForms tool) - the Electron app's own Discovery panel independently hardcodes its launch target in MigrationToolkit-Web/renderer.js and was untouched, so Discovery still launched Assessment/Run-Assessment.ps1 in its own window there, same as before. This is the exact 'wrong app' mistake called out in v2.9.152's changelog, this time caught before it shipped for more than one version

renderer.js's Discovery panel now streams search-domain.ps1 directly into the panel (window.electronAPI.onPsOutput / runStreamingScript, the same pattern every other panel here already uses) instead of opening Run-Assessment.ps1 in a separate window with a typed-prompt reminder - one run per domain via -Domain/-OutputPath/-BusinessUnitId/-SkipPowerPlatform, looping client-side for a multi-domain batch exactly as it did before v2.9.98. The VBU Search Term field and Skip Team Memberships checkbox are no longer read here - search-domain.ps1 has no equivalent parameters for either

Discovery engine: reverted discovery-menu.ps1 to the pre-v2.9.98 version (launches search-domain.ps1 / run-multiple-domains.ps1, restored to the VGMigrations root from _Legacy/ where they were left untouched) - deliberate, explicitly requested revert. Live server run of the v2.9.128 modular engine hit two separate failures in the same session: Connect-SPOService not recognized (Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell installed via pwsh7's Install-Module -Scope CurrentUser lands under Documents\PowerShell\Modules, a path the separate Windows PowerShell 5.1 process that SharePoint.psm1's -UseWindowsPowerShell proxies through never scans - Get-Module -ListAvailable in the pwsh7 session itself still found it fine, so the prerequisite check falsely reported 'present'), and a Graph connection crash ('Method not found: ...BaseAbstractApplicationBuilder.WithLogging...', an MSAL/Identity.Client assembly-version conflict against ExchangeOnlineManagement, which had already connected successfully in the same process moments earlier). search-domain.ps1 avoids both: it imports the SPO module directly under pwsh7 (no WinPS proxy) and runs its SPO connection in an isolated child process, and separately pins Microsoft.Graph.Authentication to 2.33.0 with Exchange -DisableWAM

Also fixed the same SPO WinPS-visibility false-positive in the (now unused by the GUI, but left in place) modular engine's Assessment/Modules/Prerequisites.psm1 - both the presence check and the install now go through a real powershell.exe instead of trusting the pwsh7 session's own Get-Module -ListAvailable

Assessment/Run-Assessment.ps1 and Run-MultiAssessment.ps1 (not currently launched by discovery-menu.ps1, but kept working for anyone invoking them directly) now accept -VbuDomain/-VbuSearchTerm/-VbuId/-SharePointAdminUrl/-OutputPath instead of only prompting interactively; 'Generate Mapping Files' removed from Run-Assessment.ps1's mode menu (Invoke-MappingFileGeneration and its branch left in place, just unreachable from the menu)

fly-connector.js (AvePoint Fly connection automation): fixed a ReferenceError crashing Microsoft Teams Chat connection creation (a block-scoped variable was read outside the block it was declared in), fixed the Connections-page navigation retry logic that was toggling the Settings nav menu closed instead of leaving it open on a retry (hiding the Connections item and guaranteeing the fallback selector ran - which itself only matched the literal text 'Connection', never the real 'Connections' label, also fixed), and added a fast-fail check for Fly's own 'Select at least one authentication method to proceed' validation error immediately after clicking Save instead of sitting through a 90-second timeout chain before failing anyway

New-AzureAppRegistration.ps1: fixed the credentials text-file save assuming $env:USERPROFILE\Desktop, which doesn't exist when Desktop is OneDrive-redirected (Known Folder Move) - now resolves the real Desktop path via [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')
